facts.label: Passado: dia de trabalho
facts.sub: Use started, finished, called, wrote e sent para contar o dia. Use at com hora e before com limite. Pergunte Did you have lunch? e responda No, I didn’t.

facts.label: Dia longo
facts.sub: Para contar um dia longo, siga a ordem: hora de início, problema, o que fez e como se sente. I started at seven, a client called, I wrote a report, I’m exhausted.

facts.label: Horários
facts.sub: Use at para a hora: at seven, at nine. Use before para limite: before eight. Para duração, use for: for ten hours. Preposições corretas deixam o relato claro.

pages.title: A quiet office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine at night in a quiet office in Houston. Most desks are empty, and the lights are low. Eva closes her laptop with a long sigh. Her colleague Mina walks in with her coat. She sees Eva’s tired face. She asks about the day.
“Hi, Eva! You look exhausted.” says Mina. “I am. I started at seven and finished at nine tonight.” says Eva. “Why so late? What happened?” says Mina.
